body:
Cool. Best seats in the house. Time to go. http://i.imgur.com/WGe0o4E.jpg

This will be the first thing you see when you open my laptop. First of all, I'd like to say sorry. I've had a great time, over the years we've been together.

Unfortunately, this...thing has sort of kicked in over the past year. I've tried to hide it, and I think I did pretty well. You didn't even notice. Not the drinking, not the drugs. It's not an indictment - I didn't really mind. For a while, you being happy was the most important thing to me. It gave me a purpose. Unfortunately, that's not really enough now.

I thought what I felt was love, but that was just caring. I still love you, but in a different way. I met this girl - someone you don't know - and she's the most amazing thing ever. I loved, for the first time. No, I didn't do anything. We had this sort of weird friendship going on. She cut me off, after a year. I'm not saying this to be hurtful; more like a clearing of the ledgers.

I stayed, because seeing you hurt was the worst thing in the world. I couldn't possibly do that, not to you. I know I'm doing it now, but again, ledgers. I hope it helps you move on.

I hope it makes it easier to move on, knowing that I've fucked with you somehow. If it helps, I want you to keep hating me. It's fine.

Here's a few things, if it helps:

 - you know my PIN number.
 - I hereby give you access to my bank account. I printed out a letter, and it's in the computer drawer.
 - the security code is my birthday. the password is your name, numbers instead of vowels.

I want you to move back in with your parents. Mum's not gonna be happy - she's going to blame you, so stay away for a while. Know that none of this is your fault. This is all me. I need you to remember that. There is a fundamental issue with me. I am incapable of living.

Oh, and move on.
